brief: Wildfires rage across Europe and the US, while political shake-ups in Maine and India dominate headlines. AI and tech stories include tokenized cows in Brazil and a new open-weight AI framework.
news_summary: Devastating wildfires in France, Spain, and Scotland force mass evacuations and military aid requests; a fourth firefighter dies in Colorado. In Maine, Susan Collins holds a large cash advantage, and Troy Jackson becomes the new Democratic nominee after a chaotic primary. India's education minister resigns following 'Cockroach' youth protests.
papers_summary: New research explores usability of AI conversational agents, AR accessibility for deaf students, and a visual query tool for logic programming. A paper on edge bundling taxonomies and another on Flint, a semantic visualization language, advance data visualization methods.

zh.brief: 中國學者王虹與另一位數學家首奪菲爾茲獎，為中國科學界寫下歷史。與此同時，歐洲與北美野火肆虐，數十萬人撤離；美國緬因州參議員補選因候選人出軌而出現變數。
zh.news_summary: 中國學者王虹榮獲菲爾茲獎，成為首位獲此殊榮的中國公民及第三位女性得主。法國、西班牙及英國蘇格蘭野火持續蔓延，逾25萬人疏散；美國緬因州參議員選舉因原民主黨候選人涉性侵退選，由進步派前州參議長傑克森接棒。
zh.papers_summary: 今日無優先中文論文，英文論文聚焦於AI輔助寫作、可穿戴創意工具、擴增實境輔助失聰學生、以及數據可視化與邊緣捆綁等領域。
